name: BSDTwist.a_p_twist
statement:
theorem a_p_twist (n : ℤ) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hn : (n : ZMod p) ≠ 0) :
    a_p n p = quadraticChar (ZMod p) (n : ZMod p) * a_p 1 p

name: BSDDeuring.sum_quadraticChar_comp_eq_mul_of_odd

name: HodgeChi.chi_general
statement:
theorem chi_general (d : ℚ) (n : ℕ) :
    (1 - d) ^ (n + 2) - 1 + ((n : ℚ) + 2) * d
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n + 2).choose (k + 2) : ℚ) * (-d) ^ (k + 2)

name: Panoptic.duplicado_sube_pero_uno_a_uno_baja
statement:
theorem duplicado_sube_pero_uno_a_uno_baja
    (s v : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hd : 0 < den n fp fn)
    (hv : pq s n fp fn < v) :
    pq s n fp fn < pq (s + v) (n + 1) fp fn ∧ pq s n (fp + 1) fn < pq s n fp fn

name: Panoptic.pq_def
statement: lemma pq_def (s : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) : pq s n fp fn = s / den n fp fn

name: Panoptic.pq_dup_iff
statement:
theorem pq_dup_iff (s v : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 0 < den n fp fn) :
    pq s n fp fn < pq (s + v) (n + 1) fp fn ↔ pq s n fp fn < v

name: Panoptic.pq_fp_lt
statement:
theorem pq_fp_lt (s : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hd : 0 < den n fp fn) :
    pq s n (fp + 1) fn < pq s n fp fn

name: Panoptic.pq_lt_pq_dup
statement:
theorem pq_lt_pq_dup (s v : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 0 < den n fp fn)
    (hv : pq s n fp fn < v) : pq s n fp fn < pq (s + v) (n + 1) fp fn

name: Panoptic.candidato_le_pq
statement:
theorem candidato_le_pq (s p j : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 0 < den n fp fn)
    (h : p * j ≤ pq s n fp fn / 2) : pqCandidato s p j n fp fn ≤ pq s n fp fn

name: Panoptic.den_acierto
statement:
lemma den_acierto (n fp m : ℕ) :
    den (n + 1) fp m = den n fp (m + 1) + 1 / 2

name: Panoptic.den_fallo
statement:
lemma den_fallo (n fp m : ℕ) :
    den n (fp + 1) (m + 1) = den n fp (m + 1) + 1 / 2

name: Panoptic.pq_candidato_iff
statement:
theorem pq_candidato_iff (s p j : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 0 < den n fp fn) :
    pq s n fp fn < pqCandidato s p j n fp fn ↔ pq s n fp fn / 2 < p * j

name: Panoptic.pq_lt_candidato
statement:
theorem pq_lt_candidato (s p j : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 0 < den n fp fn)
    (h : pq s n fp fn / 2 < p * j) : pq s n fp fn < pqCandidato s p j n fp fn

name: Panoptic.umbral_equilibrio
statement:
theorem umbral_equilibrio (s p j : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 0 < den n fp fn)
    (hj : 0 < j) :
    pq s n fp fn < pqCandidato s p j n fp fn ↔ pq s n fp fn / (2 * j) < p

name: PanopticFamilia.den_fp
statement:
lemma den_fp (a b : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    den a b n (fp + 1) fn = den a b n fp fn + a

name: PanopticFamilia.den_nonneg
statement:
lemma den_nonneg {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ den a b n fp fn

name: PanopticFamilia.den_succ
statement:
lemma den_succ (a b : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    den a b (n + 1) fp fn = den a b n fp fn + 1

name: PanopticFamilia.dup_iff
statement:
theorem dup_iff (a b s v : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 0 < den a b n fp fn) :
    m a b s n fp fn < m a b (s + v) (n + 1) fp fn ↔ m a b s n fp fn < v

name: PanopticFamilia.fp_baja
statement:
theorem fp_baja (a b s : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hd : 0 < den a b n fp fn) :
    m a b s n (fp + 1) fn < m a b s n fp fn

name: PanopticFamilia.fp_no_baja
statement:
theorem fp_no_baja (b s : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    m 0 b s n (fp + 1) fn = m 0 b s n fp fn

name: PanopticFamilia.m_def
statement: lemma m_def (a b s : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) : m a b s n fp fn = s / den a b n fp fn

name: PanopticFamilia.ningun_peso_lo_arregla
statement:
theorem ningun_peso_lo_arregla (s v : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < den a b n fp fn → m a b s n fp fn < v →
      m a b s n fp fn < m a b (s + v) (n + 1) fp fn

name: PanopticFamilia.pq_es_instancia
statement:
theorem pq_es_instancia (s : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    Panoptic.pq s n fp fn = m (1/2) (1/2) s n fp fn

name: PanopticFamilia.sube_o_baja_segun_se_cuente
statement:
theorem sube_o_baja_segun_se_cuente (a b s v : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hs : 0 < s) (hd : 0 < den a b n fp fn)
    (hv : m a b s n fp fn < v) :
    m a b s n fp fn < m a b (s + v) (n + 1) fp fn ∧
      m a b s n (fp + 1) fn < m a b s n fp fn

name: Panoptic.den_quitar_acierto
statement:
lemma den_quitar_acierto (n fp m : ℕ) :
    den n fp (m + 1) = den (n + 1) fp m - 1 / 2

name: Panoptic.den_quitar_fallo
statement:
lemma den_quitar_fallo (n fp m : ℕ) :
    den n fp m = den n (fp + 1) m - 1 / 2

name: Panoptic.pq_lt_quitar
statement:
theorem pq_lt_quitar (s p j : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 1 / 2 < den n fp fn)
    (h : p * j < pq s n fp fn / 2) : pq s n fp fn < pqQuitar s p j n fp fn

name: Panoptic.pq_quitar_iff
statement:
theorem pq_quitar_iff (s p j : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 1 / 2 < den n fp fn) :
    pq s n fp fn < pqQuitar s p j n fp fn ↔ p * j < pq s n fp fn / 2

name: Panoptic.quitar_candidato
statement:
theorem quitar_candidato (s p j : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    (s + p * j - p * j) / (den n fp fn + 1 / 2 - 1 / 2) = pq s n fp fn

name: Panoptic.quitar_le_pq
statement:
theorem quitar_le_pq (s p j : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 1 / 2 < den n fp fn)
    (h : pq s n fp fn / 2 ≤ p * j) : pqQuitar s p j n fp fn ≤ pq s n fp fn

name: Panoptic.card_inter_gt_of_iou
statement:
lemma card_inter_gt_of_iou (P A : Finset α) (h : (1 : ℝ) / 2 < iou P A) :
    (P.card : ℝ) < 2 * ((P ∩ A).card : ℝ)

name: Panoptic.den_una_anotacion
statement:
lemma den_una_anotacion (tp m a : ℕ) (h1 : tp ≤ m) (h2 : tp ≤ a) :
    den tp (m - tp) (a - tp) = ((m : ℝ) + a) / 2

name: Panoptic.empareja_a_lo_sumo_una
statement:
theorem empareja_a_lo_sumo_una (P A B : Finset α) (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (hA : (1 : ℝ) / 2 < iou P A) (hB : (1 : ℝ) / 2 < iou P B) : False

name: Panoptic.pq_lt_one_de_desacuerdo
statement:
theorem pq_lt_one_de_desacuerdo (sA sB : ℝ) (m a b tpA tpB : ℕ)
    (hab : a < b) (hA : tpA ≤ a) (hB : tpB ≤ m)
    (hsA : sA ≤ tpA) (hsB : sB ≤ tpB) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (sA + sB) / ((m : ℝ) + ((a : ℝ) + b) / 2) < 1

name: Panoptic.techo_dos_anotadores
statement:
theorem techo_dos_anotadores (m a b tpA tpB : ℕ)
    (hab : a < b) (hA : tpA ≤ a) (hB : tpB ≤ m) :
    ((tpA : ℝ) + tpB) < (m : ℝ) + ((a : ℝ) + b) / 2

name: Panoptic.empata_con_dos_en_un_medio
statement:
theorem empata_con_dos_en_un_medio :
    ∃ (P A B : Finset ℕ), Disjoint A B ∧ (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ iou P A ∧ (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ iou P B

name: Panoptic.iou_testigo
statement: lemma iou_testigo : iou ({1, 2} : Finset ℕ) ({1, 2, 3, 4} : Finset ℕ) = 1 / 2

name: Panoptic.umbral_exacto
statement:
theorem umbral_exacto :
    (∀ (P A B : Finset ℕ), Disjoint A B → (1 : ℝ) / 2 < iou P A → (1 : ℝ) / 2 < iou P B → False)
    ∧ ¬ (∀ (P A B : Finset ℕ), Disjoint A B → (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ iou P A → (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ iou P B → False)

name: Redheffer.crux_general
statement:
theorem crux_general (N : ℕ) (u : Fin (N + 1) → ℤ) :
    ((zeta (N + 1)).updateCol 0 u).det = ∑ j, murow N j * u j

name: Redheffer.det_zeta
statement: theorem det_zeta (N : ℕ) : (zeta N).det = 1

name: Redheffer.fila_inversa
statement:
theorem fila_inversa (N : ℕ) :
    murow N = Matrix.vecMul (fun k => if k = (0 : Fin (N + 1)) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      (zeta (N + 1))⁻¹

name: Redheffer.fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum
statement:
theorem fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum (N : ℕ) (m : ℕ) (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hmN : m ≤ N) :
    (∑ x : Fin N, if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ m then (μ ((x : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ) else 0)
      = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, (μ d : ℤ)

name: Redheffer.mertens_1
statement: theorem mertens_1 : mertens 1 = 1

name: Redheffer.mertens_2
statement: theorem mertens_2 : mertens 2 = 0

name: Redheffer.mertens_3
statement: theorem mertens_3 : mertens 3 = -1

name: Redheffer.mertens_peel
statement: theorem mertens_peel (N : ℕ) : mertens (N + 1) = 1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (N + 1), (μ k : ℤ)

name: Redheffer.range_a_Icc2
statement:
theorem range_a_Icc2 (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (μ (i + 2) : ℤ)) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (N + 1), (μ k : ℤ)

name: Redheffer.redheffer_1
statement: theorem redheffer_1 : (redheffer 1).det = mertens 1

name: Redheffer.redheffer_2
statement: theorem redheffer_2 : (redheffer 2).det = mertens 2

name: Redheffer.redheffer_3
statement: theorem redheffer_3 : (redheffer 3).det = mertens 3

name: Redheffer.redheffer_de_crux
statement:
theorem redheffer_de_crux (N : ℕ)
    (crux : ((zeta (N + 1)).updateCol 0 (fun i => if i = 0 then 0 else 1)).det
              = mertens (N + 1) - 1) :
    (redheffer (N + 1)).det = mertens (N + 1)

name: Redheffer.redheffer_eq
statement:
theorem redheffer_eq (N : ℕ) :
    redheffer (N + 1) = (zeta (N + 1)).updateCol 0 (fun _ => 1)

name: Redheffer.redheffer_general
statement: theorem redheffer_general (N : ℕ) : (redheffer (N + 1)).det = mertens (N + 1)

name: Redheffer.redheffer_pesada
statement:
theorem redheffer_pesada (N : ℕ) :
    ((zeta (N + 1)).updateCol 0 (fun i => (i : ℤ) + 1)).det = mertens_pesada (N + 1)

name: Redheffer.redheffer_reduccion
statement:
theorem redheffer_reduccion (N : ℕ) :
    (redheffer (N + 1)).det
      = 1 + ((zeta (N + 1)).updateCol 0 (fun i => if i = 0 then 0 else 1)).det

name: Redheffer.suma_a_mertens
statement:
theorem suma_a_mertens (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ j : Fin (N + 1), (if j = 0 then (0 : ℤ) else murow N j)) = mertens (N + 1) - 1

name: Redheffer.suma_mu_divisores
statement:
theorem suma_mu_divisores (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors k, (μ d : ℤ)) = if k = 1 then 1 else 0

name: Redheffer.vecMul_mu_zeta
statement:
theorem vecMul_mu_zeta (N : ℕ) :
    Matrix.vecMul (murow N) (zeta (N + 1)) = fun k => if k = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else 0

name: Redheffer.zeta_blockTriangular
statement: theorem zeta_blockTriangular (N : ℕ) : (zeta N).BlockTriangular id

name: Redheffer.zeta_col0
statement:
theorem zeta_col0 (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    zeta (N + 1) i 0 = (if i = 0 then 1 else 0)

name: Smith.det_diagPhi
statement:
theorem det_diagPhi (N : ℕ) :
    (diagPhi N).det = ∏ i : Fin N, (Nat.totient ((i : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ)

name: Smith.diagG_mul_zeta
statement:
theorem diagG_mul_zeta (N : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℤ) (d j : Fin N) :
    (diagG N g * zeta N) d j = if (d : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then g ((d : ℕ) + 1) else 0

name: Smith.diagPhi_mul_zeta
statement:
theorem diagPhi_mul_zeta (N : ℕ) (d j : Fin N) :
    (diagPhi N * zeta N) d j
      = if (d : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then (Nat.totient ((d : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ) else 0

name: Smith.entrada_factorizacion
statement:
theorem entrada_factorizacion (N : ℕ) (i j : Fin N) :
    ((zeta N)ᵀ * (diagPhi N * zeta N)) i j = smith N i j

name: Smith.entrada_factorizacion_general
statement:
theorem entrada_factorizacion_general (N : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → f m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) (i j : Fin N) :
    ((zeta N)ᵀ * (diagG N g * zeta N)) i j = smithF N f i j

name: Smith.fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum_phi
statement:
theorem fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum_phi (N : ℕ) (m : ℕ) (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hmN : m ≤ N) :
    (∑ x : Fin N, if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ m then (Nat.totient ((x : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ) else 0)
      = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, (Nat.totient d : ℤ)

name: Smith.smithF_determinant
statement:
theorem smithF_determinant (N : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → f m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) :
    (smithF N f).det = ∏ i : Fin N, g ((i : ℕ) + 1)

name: Smith.smithF_eq_factorizacion
statement:
theorem smithF_eq_factorizacion (N : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → f m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) :
    smithF N f = (zeta N)ᵀ * (diagG N g * zeta N)

name: Smith.smith_clasico_de_general
statement:
theorem smith_clasico_de_general (N : ℕ) :
    (smithF N (fun n => (n : ℤ))).det = ∏ i : Fin N, (Nat.totient ((i : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ)

name: Smith.smith_determinant
statement:
theorem smith_determinant (N : ℕ) :
    (smith N).det = ∏ i : Fin N, (Nat.totient ((i : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ)

name: Smith.smith_eq_factorizacion
statement:
theorem smith_eq_factorizacion (N : ℕ) :
    smith N = (zeta N)ᵀ * (diagPhi N * zeta N)

name: Smith.smith_sigmaK_de_general
statement:
theorem smith_sigmaK_de_general (N k : ℕ) :
    (smithF N (fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.sigma k n : ℤ))).det
      = (∏ i : Fin N, ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ)) ^ k

name: Smith.smith_sigma_de_general
statement:
theorem smith_sigma_de_general (N : ℕ) :
    (smithF N (fun n => (∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors n, d : ℤ))).det
      = ∏ i : Fin N, ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ)

name: Smith.smith_tau_de_general
statement:
theorem smith_tau_de_general (N : ℕ) :
    (smithF N (fun n => (n.divisors.card : ℤ))).det = 1

name: SmithLCM.det_diagId
statement:
theorem det_diagId (N : ℕ) :
    (diagId N).det = ∏ i : Fin N, (((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)

name: SmithLCM.det_diagR
statement:
theorem det_diagR (N : ℕ) (g : ℕ → R) :
    (diagR N g).det = ∏ i : Fin N, g ((i : ℕ) + 1)

name: SmithLCM.det_lcm
statement:
theorem det_lcm (N : ℕ) :
    (lcmMat N).det
      = (∏ i : Fin N, (((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))
        * (∏ i : Fin N, (((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))
        * ∏ i : Fin N, gLcm ((i : ℕ) + 1)

name: SmithLCM.det_lcmMat
statement:
theorem det_lcmMat (N : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℚ)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → (1 : ℚ) / m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) :
    (lcmMat N).det
      = (∏ i : Fin N, (((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))
        * (∏ i : Fin N, (((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))
        * ∏ i : Fin N, g ((i : ℕ) + 1)

name: SmithLCM.det_zetaR
statement: theorem det_zetaR (N : ℕ) : (zetaR (R := R) N).det = 1

name: SmithLCM.diagR_mul_zetaR
statement:
theorem diagR_mul_zetaR (N : ℕ) (g : ℕ → R) (d j : Fin N) :
    (diagR N g * zetaR (R := R) N) d j
      = if (d : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then g ((d : ℕ) + 1) else 0

name: SmithLCM.entrada_factorizacion_R
statement:
theorem entrada_factorizacion_R (N : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → R)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → f m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) (i j : Fin N) :
    ((zetaR (R := R) N)ᵀ * (diagR N g * zetaR (R := R) N)) i j = smithR N f i j

name: SmithLCM.fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum
statement:
theorem fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum (N m : ℕ) (g : ℕ → R) (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hmN : m ≤ N) :
    (∑ x : Fin N, if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ m then g ((x : ℕ) + 1) else 0)
      = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d

name: SmithLCM.gLcm_spec
statement:
theorem gLcm_spec (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (1 : ℚ) / m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, gLcm d

name: SmithLCM.lcmMat_eq
statement:
theorem lcmMat_eq (N : ℕ) :
    lcmMat N = diagId N * smithR N (fun m => (1 : ℚ) / m) * diagId N

name: SmithLCM.smithR_determinant
statement:
theorem smithR_determinant (N : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → R)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → f m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) :
    (smithR N f).det = ∏ i : Fin N, g ((i : ℕ) + 1)

name: SmithLCM.smithR_eq_factorizacion
statement:
theorem smithR_eq_factorizacion (N : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → R)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → f m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) :
    smithR N f = (zetaR (R := R) N)ᵀ * (diagR N g * zetaR (R := R) N)

name: SmithLCM.zetaR_blockTriangular
statement: theorem zetaR_blockTriangular (N : ℕ) : (zetaR (R := R) N).BlockTriangular id

name: SmithLCMForma.dvd_radical_of_squarefree
statement:
theorem dvd_radical_of_squarefree {d n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hd : d ∣ n) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    d ∣ radical n

name: SmithLCMForma.sum_moebius_mul_eq_prod_one_sub
statement:
theorem sum_moebius_mul_eq_prod_one_sub (f : ArithmeticFunction R)
    (hf : f.IsMultiplicative) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (μ d : R) * f d = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (1 - f p)

name: SmithLCMForma.sum_moebius_mul_id
statement:
theorem sum_moebius_mul_id {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (μ d : ℚ) * (d : ℚ)
      = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℚ))
